p.zh: FiveM 是 GTA V 的联机模组平台。装一个画质包（如 NVE、QuantV 或 ReShade 预设），画面立刻焕然一新。本教程带你一步步装好。
p.en: FiveM is the multiplayer mod platform for GTA V. Install a graphics pack (like NVE, QuantV or a ReShade preset) and the game instantly looks brand new. This guide takes you through it step by step.

note.zh: 开始前你需要：正版 GTA V（装 Legacy 传承版，见步骤 1）、显卡 GTX 1060 以上、约 30GB 空余磁盘、稳定的网络。
note.en: Before you start: a genuine GTA V (install the Legacy build — see Step 1), GPU GTX 1060 or better, ~30GB of free disk space, stable internet.

sub.zh: 先装好 FiveM 客户端

img.capZh: 图 1：安装 FiveM 的四个步骤
img.capEn: Fig 1: Four steps to install FiveM

zh: 打开 https://fivem.net，点 Download 下载安装器。
运行 FiveM.exe：它会自动安装到 C 盘，然后让你手动选择 GTA 5 文件夹（该文件夹里要有 GTA5.exe）。
等待首次安装完成（会自动下载一些必需文件）。
启动 FiveM，登录 Rockstar 账号，进一个自己国家的服务器试试能不能玩。
en: Open https://fivem.net and click Download to get the installer.
Run FiveM.exe: it installs automatically to the C: drive, then asks you to pick the GTA 5 folder (the folder must contain GTA5.exe).
Wait for the first-time setup to finish (it downloads some required files).
Launch FiveM, log in with your Rockstar account, and join a server in your own country to test.

note.zh: 重要：FiveM 现在同时支持 Legacy（传承版）和 Enhanced（增强版）两个版本（增强版 2026 年 7 月刚上线，还不稳定）。本教程只针对传承版：增强版的画质模组还不能用，社区也不成熟。用 Rockstar Launcher 安装 Grand Theft Auto V Legacy 即可。
note.en: Important: FiveM now supports both Legacy and Enhanced builds (Enhanced launched in early access in July 2026 and is still unstable). This guide targets the Legacy build: Enhanced can't use graphic mods yet and its community is immature. Install Grand Theft Auto V Legacy via Rockstar Launcher.

note.zh: 装好后桌面会出现 FiveM 图标。如果不想装画质包，现在就可以直接进游戏，本教程到此结束。
note.en: A FiveM icon appears on your desktop afterwards. If you don't want a graphics pack, you're done — just launch the game.

img.capZh: 图 2：常见画质包与下载方式
img.capEn: Fig 2: Popular packs and where to get them

zh: NaturalVision Evolved (NVE)：公认最真实，Patreon 付费，有 FiveM 专用版。
QuantV：电影感色调，风格强烈。
ENB (ENBSeries)：enbdev.com 免费下载，适合单机。
免费 ReShade 预设：GitHub 上很多，新手首选。
en: NaturalVision Evolved (NVE): widely regarded as the most realistic; paid via Patreon; has a FiveM-specific version.
QuantV: cinematic color grading, strong style.
ENB (ENBSeries): free at enbdev.com, great for single-player.
Free ReShade presets: plenty on GitHub — great for beginners.

note.zh: 下载到的通常是个 zip，先完整解压再继续。
note.en: You'll usually get a zip — extract it fully before continuing.

h2.zh: 步骤 3 · 把文件复制到 FiveM

img.capZh: 图 3：FiveM 目录结构（重点：data 文件夹）
img.capEn: Fig 3: FiveM folder structure (focus: the data folder)

h3.zh: 第 1 步：确认安装路径

zh: 画质包要装进 FiveM.app 文件夹。默认路径：C:\Users\用户名\AppData\Local\FiveM\FiveM.app（也就是 %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app）。
自定义安装则在别的位置，比如 D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app。
en: Pack files go into the FiveM.app folder. Default path: C:\Users\[YourName]\AppData\Local\FiveM\FiveM.app (same as %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app).
Custom installs live elsewhere, e.g. D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app.

zh: 把 zip 完整解压。
打开解压出来的文件夹，Ctrl + A 全选，Ctrl + C 复制。
打开 FiveM.app\data 文件夹，Ctrl + V 粘贴；提示合并/替换就选"是"。
画质包自带 Mods、Plugins 等文件夹？直接一起拷进去，不用自己建。（具体说明见下方进阶章节）
（可选）删掉 caches 文件夹，让游戏重新生成缓存，能避免画质包冲突。
少数画质包（如 NVE）要求放 FiveM.app 根目录而不是 data，以画质包自带说明为准。
en: Extract the zip fully.
Open the extracted folder, press Ctrl + A to select everything, then Ctrl + C to copy.
Open FiveM.app\data, press Ctrl + V to paste; choose "Yes" when asked to merge/replace.
The pack ships its own Mods / Plugins folders? Copy them in as-is — don't create anything manually. (Details in the Advanced section below)
(Optional) Delete the caches folder so the game regenerates it — avoids conflicts.
A few packs (e.g. NVE) want files in the FiveM.app root instead of data — always follow the pack's instructions.

h2.zh: 步骤 4 · 安装 ReShade（可选）

video.badgeZh: 视频来自 GitHub（CDN 加载）
video.badgeEn: Video hosted on GitHub (served via CDN)
video.capZh: 视频：请将安装演示视频上传到 GitHub 的 assets/video/ 文件夹
video.capEn: Video: upload your demo video to assets/video/ in your GitHub repo

zh: 从 https://reshade.me 下载并运行 ReShade 安装器。
点 Select game，选 GTA V 传承版目录里的 GTA5.exe（例如 steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V\GTA5.exe）。别选 FiveM.exe，FiveM 会忽略它。
接口选 DirectX 10/11/12，勾选下载着色器（Standard effects 等）。
装完后打开 GTA V 目录，把生成的 dxgi.dll、ReShade.ini、ReShadePreset.ini、ReShade.log 和 reshade-shaders 文件夹剪切到 FiveM.app\plugins。
画质包自带的 ReShade 预设（.ini）也放进 FiveM.app\plugins。
en: Download and run the ReShade installer from https://reshade.me.
Click Select game and pick GTA5.exe in your GTA V Legacy folder (e.g. steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V\GTA5.exe). Do not pick FiveM.exe — FiveM ignores it.
Select DirectX 10/11/12 and tick the shaders to download (Standard effects, etc.).
After installing, open the GTA V folder and cut the generated dxgi.dll, ReShade.ini, ReShadePreset.ini, ReShade.log and the reshade-shaders folder into FiveM.app\plugins.
Also put the pack's ReShade preset (.ini) into FiveM.app\plugins.

note.zh: ReShade 装完只出现在 GTA V 目录里，FiveM 不会理它；搬进 FiveM.app\plugins 后才会生效。
note.en: ReShade files land in the GTA V folder and FiveM ignores them there — they only work after you move them into FiveM.app\plugins.

h2.zh: 步骤 5 · 启动游戏并启用画质

zh: 通过 FiveM 启动器进入任意服务器。
游戏中按 Home 键打开 ReShade 面板。
在面板顶部下拉框里选画质包预设，勾上想要的特效。
游戏设置里把高级图形开到超高，效果最好。
en: Join any server through the FiveM launcher.
Press Home in-game to open the ReShade panel.
Pick your pack preset in the dropdown at the top and enable the effects you want.
Set Advanced Graphics → Very High in game settings for the best look.

note.zh: 按 Home 没反应？多半是 dxgi.dll 不在 FiveM.app\plugins，或没在 CitizenFX.ini 里放行（见进阶章节）。
note.en: Home does nothing? Usually dxgi.dll is not in FiveM.app\plugins, or you haven't approved it in CitizenFX.ini (see Advanced).

h2.zh: 进阶内容 · RPF / ASI / ReShade Addon

sub.en: Read this when you hit these files

h3.zh: RPF：联机用不了，单机才能用
h3.en: RPF: multiplayer ignores them, single-player only

p.zh: 联机时，模型、地图等 RPF 内容由服务器统一下发，你把 .rpf 放进本地 FiveM 目录不会被加载。单机 GTA V 才用得到：用 OpenIV 导入，或放进 GTA V 的 mods 文件夹。
p.en: In multiplayer, RPF content (models, maps) is streamed by the server — .rpf files you put in your local FiveM folder will not load. They only work in single-player GTA V: import with OpenIV, or drop them into GTA V's mods folder.

h3.zh: mods 文件夹：单机 RPF 的去处
h3.en: mods folder: where single-player RPF files go

zh: 单机 GTA V 默认没有 mods 文件夹，在游戏根目录新建一个（如 D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\GTA V\mods）。
推荐用 OpenIV → Tools → Mods 模式自动生成正确的目录结构。
把 .rpf 文件（以及需要的 dlclist.xml 配置）放进 mods 对应位置。
en: Single-player GTA V has no mods folder by default — create one in the game root (e.g. D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\GTA V\mods).
(Recommended) Open OpenIV → Tools → enable Mods mode so it builds the correct structure for you.
Put the .rpf files (and any dlclist.xml changes) into the matching location inside mods.

zh: 打开 FiveM.app（默认在 %localappdata%\FiveM，自定义安装如 D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app）。
新版 FiveM 自带 plugins 文件夹；没有就自己建一个。
把 .asi 放进去，重启 FiveM 生效。
en: Open FiveM.app (default: %localappdata%\FiveM; custom installs like D:\FiveM_Legacy\FiveM.app).
Modern FiveM ships with a plugins folder; create one if missing.
Drop the .asi file in there and restart FiveM.

note.zh: 服务器可能禁用插件；过时或不兼容的插件会导致闪退，风险自负。
note.en: Servers may disallow plugins; outdated or incompatible plugins can crash the game — use at your own risk.

zh: 从 reshade.me 下载 ReShade with full add-on support（未签名版；签名版不加载任何 addon）。
.addon 是作者编译好的成品，从作者的发布页下载（如 GitHub Releases）。64 位游戏（FiveM 就是）用 .addon64，32 位用 .addon32。
把 .addon 放进 FiveM.app\plugins（ReShade 默认搜索目录）。
重启游戏，ReShade.log 里出现 Registered add-on 就说明加载成功。
en: Download ReShade with full add-on support from reshade.me (the unsigned build; the signed one loads no add-ons).
A .addon file is a ready-made binary from the author (e.g. GitHub Releases). 64-bit games (like FiveM) use .addon64, 32-bit use .addon32.
Put the .addon into FiveM.app\plugins (ReShade's default search folder).
Restart the game — Registered add-on in ReShade.log means it loaded.

note.zh: addon 版未签名，部分服务器可能当作弊封号，使用前先看服务器规则。
note.en: The add-on build is unsigned — some servers may treat it as cheating and ban you. Check server rules first.

h3.zh: ReShade 装好却没反应？（F8 放行）
h3.en: ReShade installed but nothing works? (F8 approval)

p.zh: ReShade 装得全对，但游戏里没有编译进度条、按 Home 也没反应？这是 FiveM 检测到 ReShade 后要你在配置里手动放行。
p.en: ReShade is fully installed but there's no compilation bar and Home does nothing? FiveM detected ReShade and needs your manual approval in the config.

zh: 游戏里按 F8 打开 FiveM 控制台。
找到 [Addons] ReShade5=ID:xxxxxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes 这一行。
打开 %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini（自定义安装就在对应的 FiveM.app 里）。
把控制台那行（带你自己的 ID）复制到文件最底部，格式见下。注意 ID 每台电脑不同，别照抄示例。
保存并重启 FiveM，ReShade 就能正常加载了。
en: Press F8 in-game to open the FiveM console.
Find the line [Addons] ReShade5=ID:xxxxxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes.
Open %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini (custom installs: the matching FiveM.app).
Copy that line (with your own ID) to the very bottom of the file, formatted as below. The ID is unique per PC — don't copy the example.
Save and restart FiveM — ReShade should now load normally.

body.code:
[Addons]
ReShade5=ID:xxxxxxxxxxxx acknowledged that ReShade 5.x has a bug that will lead to game crashes

note.zh: 这两行必须放在 CitizenFX.ini 的最底部（[Addons] 段），ID 换成你自己的。
note.en: These two lines must go at the very bottom of CitizenFX.ini (the [Addons] section), with your own ID.

zh.q: 游戏打不开 / 闪退怎么办？
zh.a: 删掉 FiveM.app 里的 caches 文件夹再启动；还不行就把刚复制的画质包文件删掉，逐个排查。
在 ReShade 面板少开特效（尤其是模糊、光线类），或把预设强度调低。
确认 dxgi.dll、ReShade.ini 和预设 .ini 都在 FiveM.app\plugins，并完成上面的 F8 放行。
部分服务器禁止 ReShade / 画质包。进去前在 ReShade 里点 Disable，或删掉 dxgi.dll。

zh.q: 提示 Could not find game executable（找不到游戏）？
zh.a: 打开 %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini，把 IVPath= 改成你的 GTA V 传承版目录（如 D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V），保存后重启 FiveM。

zh.q: FiveM 支持 Enhanced 增强版吗？
zh.a: 支持，但建议用传承版：增强版 2026 年 7 月刚早期访问，不稳定、画质模组还不能用，社区也不成熟。本教程针对传承版。

en.a: Delete the caches folder inside FiveM.app and relaunch. If it persists, remove the pack files you copied and test them one by one.
Disable some effects in the ReShade panel (especially blur / light effects), or lower the preset intensity.
Make sure dxgi.dll, ReShade.ini and the preset .ini are all in FiveM.app\plugins, and complete the F8 approval above.
Some servers ban ReShade / graphics packs. Click Disable in ReShade or remove dxgi.dll before joining.
Open %localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app\CitizenFX.ini and point IVPath= to your GTA V Legacy folder (e.g. D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto V), then save and restart FiveM.

en.q: Does FiveM support the Enhanced build?
en.a: Yes, but Legacy is recommended: Enhanced only entered early access in July 2026 — unstable, no graphic mods yet, immature ecosystem. This guide targets Legacy.
